title: SCAT Airlines 760
summary: SCAT Airlines Flight 760, a Bombardier CRJ200, was on final approach to Almaty International Airport in thick fog and poor visibility when it initiated a go-around at 13:13 local time on 29 January 2013. Fourteen seconds after initiating the go-around, the aircraft experienced a nose-down elevator deflection and crashed 1.6 km short of the runway near Kyzyltu. The subsequent investigation was unable to determine the cause of the elevator deflection, though a possible scenario involved pilot incapacitation from a heart attack.
probable_cause: Nose-down elevator deflection during go-around; cause undetermined but possibly pilot incapacitation from heart attack

factors.evidence: aircraft was on final approach in thick fog and poor visibility
go-around initiated due to weather conditions being below minimums
possible scenario that Captain Evdokimov may have experienced a heart attack and collapsed onto the yoke; postaccident autopsy revealed he had coronary artery disease
nose-down elevator deflection resulted in a steep dive and impact with the ground
